Thanks again for taking the product walkthrough this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the data points we still need to lock your target economics:

- Primary use: document ingestion + question answering for internal analysts (legal + ops).
- Expected steady-state volume: ~150M tokens/month (peaks to 300M in month-end runs).
- Latency SLO: 250–500ms p95 for short QA paths.
- Sensitive data: PII in ingested docs; preference for Private/VPC deployment.

Pricing qualification asks (we discussed briefly on the call):
1) Target unit price you’d consider for bulk inference (we use $/1M tokens as a standard) — any target range?
2) Expected monthly committed budget (range) once validated in pilot.
3) Will you require an enterprise reserved capacity commitment (yes/no) or prefer a pay-as-you-go pilot?

Next steps I propose:
- You share a target $/1M tokens range + preferred pilot billing model by Wednesday 8/18.
- Ben will run a short benchmark comparing those targets vs OpenAI/Anthropic and a sample of common open-model hosts and attach a one-page summary.
- We’ll send a tailored pilot proposal (costs, SLAs, onboarding milestones) within 48 hrs after we have your target range.

I attached a cost model template (Redwood-cost-model-v1.xlsx) to make it quick — fill the green cells with your expected monthly tokens and we’ll populate line-item unit economics.

Thanks — looking forward to your range.

Eleanor / Lauren —

Thanks for the ranges, Eleanor — helpful. I ran a concise cost scan against common public hosts and our internal Redwood Reserved/Hosted profiles to give you a sense of where your $180–$350 target sits. High-level numbers below are normalized to $/1M input+output tokens for comparable model classes (dense LLM for Q&A workloads). These are illustrative, we can provide raw run logs on request.

Benchmark (approximate $/1M tokens):
- OpenAI (latest multimodal endpoint): ~$1,100 / 1M (hosted, lowest latency but highest sticker price)
- Anthropic (Claude family): ~$850 / 1M (hosted)
- Generic cloud-hosted open-model providers (managed endpoints): $420–$700 / 1M (depends on GPU type and batching)
- Self-hosted on common GPU profiles (amortized infra + ops): ~$300–$450 / 1M (higher ops burden)
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity, 3-yr amort + autoscaler): ~$160–$290 / 1M depending on committed size and caching effectiveness

Takeaways relative to Finlytics targets:
- Your $180–$350 target overlaps directly with the Redwood Dedicated band; if a reserved commitment is acceptable you can hit the lower end ($~160–$200) for predictable workloads.
- For a hosted pilot (no long-term commit) your acceptable upper bound ($350) is feasible but would land in the managed open-host range where throughput/latency tradeoffs become more important.
- Significant savings unlocked by: prefix/KV caching, batching config aligned to your request size distribution, and model quantization. We can show a sample before/after on your sample dataset.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short host comparisons PDF (hosting-benchmarks-summary.pdf) and a sample run table. Also pasted below is a quick delta table for the $/1M buckets so you have a one-line summary for procurement: 

Quick delta table (round numbers):
- OpenAI vs Redwood Dedicated: ~+600–900 / 1M (OpenAI higher)
- Anthropic vs Redwood Dedicated: ~+500–700 / 1M (Anthropic higher)
- Managed host vs Redwood Dedicated: ~+140–270 / 1M (managed hosts often higher unless heavily optimized)

Next steps (proposed):
1) Eleanor: confirm whether the pilot should be hosted or reserved (you indicated pay-as-you-go to start — we can still provision a reserved-capacity pricing option to compare).
2) If reserved is of interest, we’ll prepare two price ladders: 3-month pilot (non-committal) vs 12-month reserved contract with tiered unit pricing tied to committed tokens.
3) Compliance ask: we’ll send SOC 2 evidence and a quick KMS integration note to Markus today.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-min call to walk through the spreadsheet results if useful.

— Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
